notes.title: Silent Residence the Small Update
notes.content: [h1]Thank you, everyone! ːsteamhappyː[/h1][p]Hello everyone! Thank you for playing Silent Residence and experiencing Harry's story of his schizophrenia case! I want to share a small update for the main build of the game! Again, thank you, everyone, for playing Silent Residence![/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Spelling mistake corrections[/p][/*][*][p]Movement bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]"Medications" achievement is properly implemented [/p][/*][*][p]"Officer Ramirez" achievement is properly implemented[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New[/h3][list][*][p][spoiler]Michelle's Body is now visible in the police scenario[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]Russian (ru) translation added thanks to Kobbo![/p][/*][/list]
